arms.CONTROL: Fresh V7 initialization; original 48 confounded Count tasks; unchanged 48 Object tasks and 288 replay tasks.
arms.TREATMENT: Fresh V7 initialization; 48 counterbalanced Count tasks; all 336 non-Count slots identical to Control.

conditional_query_only_followup.comparison_if_triggered: Equal-Slot CE versus Query-Only CE on identical deconfounded data in a separate experiment.
conditional_query_only_followup.trigger: Equal-Slot plus deconfounded data has query train-fit <43/48 while demonstration-output fit >=90%, or a separately authorized component-gradient measurement finds demo-versus-query cosine <=0.

estimand: Treatment minus Control paired exact-grid accuracy on 48 fresh structural-OOD canonical units, clustering the two demo orders within canonical unit.

evaluation.composition: Existing non-duplicative Count-then-Object-Extraction sentinel; no-harm only.
evaluation.primary_ood: 48 fresh structural-OOD canonical units, two fixed demo orders each; exact grid; paired canonical-unit bootstrap CI.
evaluation.references: V7 is required. Historical V2 Control/Treatment are descriptive references only and are not causal arms in this experiment.
evaluation.retention: Existing protected target-blind panel; paired family-level and aggregate exact-grid deltas.
evaluation.train_fit: 48 Count training queries per arm; synthetic targets opened only after raw prediction freeze.

fixed.objective: Original Equal-Slot all-assistant CE; no Code-Pair weighting; no Query-Only masking.

hypothesis: Counterbalancing topology, count, demo order, color, and rotation in Count training improves free-running structural-OOD Count accuracy relative to the original shortcut-confounded curriculum.

predeclared_rules.composition: No loss >1 correct versus Control; this sentinel cannot establish compositional mastery.
predeclared_rules.order_invariance: Treatment correct under both orders on >=80% of its OOD-correct canonical units and not worse than Control.
predeclared_rules.primary_success: Treatment-Control >=6/48 canonical units and paired canonical-unit bootstrap 95% lower bound >0.
predeclared_rules.promotion: No promotion from this pilot; a new independent frozen confirmation is required.
predeclared_rules.retention: No protected family loses >1 correct versus Control and aggregate protected delta >=-2.
predeclared_rules.valid_train_fit: Treatment >=43/48 exact; otherwise classify as supervision/optimization failure.
